remarks: Penthouse living in the heart of Brentwood. Perched on the fourth and top floor of an intimate, gated eight-residence building, this spacious 3-bedroom, 2.5-bath condominium offers a rare combination of privacy, generous proportions, and an exceptional Brentwood location. Expansive living and dining spaces are filled with natural light, while sliding glass doors open to a private balcony with city views and the Getty Museum visible in the distance. The thoughtful floor plan features three generously sized bedrooms, including a spacious primary suite with en-suite bath and ample closet space.
